$description: DataGrid cell additions use existing roles.

data-grid-cell-deleted-text.$description: Muted text for a deleted value; italic is also used.

data-grid-range-background.$description: DataGrid cell selection (the option cellSelection): the fill of a cell inside the selected block (the selected state's, as a navigation row's current fill).

data-grid-range-border-color.$description: DataGrid cell selection: the border around the selected block (on its outer edges only), in the selected content color so it reads against the selected fill.

data-grid-range-border-width.$description: DataGrid cell selection: the width of the block's border (2px).
